outcome: Success of trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: 337 women with a history of one cesarean birth who underwent a trial of labor with a singleton live born fetus in cephalic presentation at least 37 weeks of gestation
finding: History of vaginal birth, especially after a previous cesarean delivery, was positively associated with successful TOLAC, while obesity, absence of epidural anesthesia, induction of labor, delivery at or after 41 weeks, and male fetal sex were negatively associated with successful TOLAC.
